title: 1936 Prairie: the Allerton tower stands square
items: The Allerton house's belvedere tower on Prairie Avenue is now square, as its winter photograph and the 1911 fire map show it, instead of an eight-sided shaft. It stands 1.3 m out from the front, the map's depth, with one round-headed window on each face of the belvedere and a stone balustrade round its flat top.
